profile.headline: Sr Software Engineer
profile.summary:
A Full Stack Developer, working on MEN Stack (MongoDb, Express and Node js) for web application.

Experienced Software Automation Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the industrial automation industry. Skilled in Python, C++, Mobile Applications, Automated Software Testing, and .NET Framework. Strong quality assurance professional with a Bachelor's degree focused in Computer Science from California State University-Fullerton.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led the redesign of the tax payment website for Orange County, resulting in improved user experience and efficiency.

• Coordinated application deployments and collaborated with cross-functional teams.
• Designed and developed Intranet and Internet websites for OC Tax Treasurer.
• Rewrote the classic asp tax payment website for Orange County.
positions.insights: Skills: ASP.NET Core · Angular · Microsoft Azure · JavaScript · Docker · Kubernetes · Software Design · Software Infrastructure

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description: Outgoing Project for Orange County, California

positions.title: Sr Application Developer
positions.description:
Collabera provides software engineering solutions for the world’s most tech-forward organizations in the areas of engineering, Cloud and Data/ AI. With its roots serving the engineering needs of the world’s most recognized businesses in technology, financial services, telecom, and healthcare, Collabera today operates across 60 locations in 11 countries, serves 30% of the Fortune 500, and has exceeded the industry growth rate by 3-4x for several years, with revenues now approaching $1B annually.

 Ongoing project with SAIC https://www.saic.com/

company.name: Junior Mern stack looking for work

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Perform Test Automation and setting up frameworks on multiple application platforms like Web, Mobile, and Desktop.
- Create & manage bug reports and communicate with the team.
- Working with Selenium, Appium framework in designing, development, and writing testing.
- Participate in test automation tool development  and may make it for generic use.

positions.title: Software Automation Engineer
positions.description:
- Experience using GitHub, TFS or similar source control systems.
- Proficient scripting skills. (Powershell, Python, windows command line)
- Maintain the design and maintenance of software system
- Familiarity with QA and test automation software is a plus (coded UI framework)
- Manage vms on vcloud using for testing environment
- Build utilities if needed to automate/simplify daily work.
- Maintain headless test framework using nodejs technology
- Working experience in Microsoft SQL databases, development and troubleshooting
- Working experience with application lifecycle methodologies in agile process
- Help people in team to run private builds and analyze result.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
- Worked with QA team lead on stories/task for each sprint/PSI
- Analyzed daily build's result and raised defects if needed
- Wrote MTM test cases and automated them
- Created UI keywords needed in the test framework

honors.title: CSU/Edison Scholarship
honors.description:
The CSU/Edison Scholars Program has been established by a partnership between five California State University campuses and Edison International.

The purpose of this scholarship is to increase the number of low income and first generation students earning degrees in technical fields.

Edison International has pledged $200,000 for a one year period to the California State University System to be used for Student Scholarships. 

These funds will provide scholarships to community college students who transfer to one of five CSU institutions.
